reason: No native measurements were available when M0 was implemented. Fix budgets after repeated same-profile C++ baseline measurements and before Rust comparison.
method: Record source and executable hashes, build profile, toolchain, warm/cold condition, sample count, elapsed time and peak RSS. A single capture elapsed_seconds value is diagnostic, not a performance acceptance result.
production_first_frame: PENDING until M7/M8 supplies a controlled synthetic filesystem/OS environment for both unchanged production bootstraps. Safe --self-check/--offline-demo or injected frontend timings do not measure this.
rust_scaffold: No runtime or performance parity claim. The M0 perf command is explicitly unimplemented.
